data.exact_reserve_text: The net provision release which totalled GBP 33.9m (2016: GBP 68.3m).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4141 reported an opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) of GBP 155.088m (balance sheet 2016 comparative). The report describes a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 33.9m in 2017, driven by favourable claims development across the portfolio. No gross prior-year movement figure was clearly presented in a single, unambiguous 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' movement line in the notes available, so the quantified movement used here is the net (after reinsurance) figure reported in the managing agent's commentary.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities/gross) was not unambiguously located in the notes that could be read. The report clearly states a net (after reinsurance) prior year release of GBP 33.9m in the managing agent commentary; no explicit gross (insurance liabilities) movement figure was located in the available notes/printed tables. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (prior-year comparative column). Claims development triangle is present in the report but numeric cells could not be confidently digitised from the provided images. Where gross figures could not be located, a NET figure was used and flagged here.
